canvas.empty: Open a sprite from the Gallery to edit it

dock.pixelGridHint: Draws a line at every sprite pixel. It hides itself below six screen pixels per sprite pixel, where it would be a grey wash rather than a grid.
dock.checkerboardHint: Shows transparent pixels as a checker pattern.

tools.label: Sprite Tools
tools.empty: Open a sprite from the Gallery to adjust it.
tools.adjustHint: An image that looks like pixel art is not pixel art. These make it pixel art.
tools.targetHint: Leave a field empty to have the engine measure the grid the sprite is actually drawn on, instead of imposing one.
tools.ditherHint: Applied once the sprite is down to size, so the pattern lands on the sprite's own pixels. An ordered pattern is identical in every frame; error diffusion is not, and makes flat areas crawl during playback.
tools.alphaThresholdHint: How much of a cell has to be subject before that cell is drawn at all. Higher tightens the silhouette.
tools.noPalette: Reduce the colours in Adjust to get a palette.
tools.paletteHint: The colours this sprite uses, most used first.
